gameDissections.evidenceSummary: In G04 (00:50 CST, 3-team match, map=10 931x959, land=546,152, H=48), Team 1 led through t=5422 with 248,433 team land (45.5% of map vs Team 2's 226,797 = 41.5% and collapsing Team 3's 66,931 = 12.3%), anchored by leo_tx (28,816L), noah88 (20,018L), and lucas94 (18,243L). Two lethal V7 frontline-draining cascades threw the match: (1) At t=4860->4950, frontline shield kevin_k (L=7,296, B=473,185, d=64.9) fired 7 consecutive buyLand pulses in 90 ticks under oppFloorCap=38 + totB=B+myOut + isPrimeLand keep<=10~26*L, draining his home balance to B=115 (d=0.02!) and dying at t=5422; (2) Between t=6300 and t=6660, while squad land peaked at 63,806 (leo_tx 28,816, noah88 20,018, lucas94 18,092), lucas94 bled his home density from 98.4 down to 27.8 (bordering nb=3 enemies) via buyLand over-extension, and at t=6594..6622 noah88 (L=17,259, B=1,673,120, d=96.9) fired 14 machine-gun 10%B assist pokes in 28 ticks (plus 1 buyLand pulse + 3 boats) against enemy=23([CN]) due to the 2-tick RTT inflight lock expiring before server echo, crashing his home density from 96.9 to 33.8. Meanwhile, boxed-in rear bank leo_tx (27,199L, nb=0) was bled to d=72.5~76.4 by 79 squad micro-donations. Team 2 counter-attacked the hollowed-out d=27.8~33.8 frontline at t=6660 and swept noah88 (collapsed by t=6840, died t=7404), lucas94 (t=6988), and leo_tx (hit by a 5-poke assist self-drain at t=6950..6958 from d=74.1 to 39.7, died t=7237).

variableEvaluations.baseline80PctValue: oppFloorCap=128, collapseFloorCap=85, avail = B - fee - keep (home B only, no 10*L prime override, curAtk <= 4%B, period=3..5, inflight=8 ticks)
variableEvaluations.recommendedOptimalValue: oppFloorCap=112, collapseFloorCap=68, avail = B - fee - keep (strictly exclude in-flight myOut from buyLand budget), thirdPartySafe floor >= max(68*L, (max3rdB - 1.5*L)/1.55) when humanNbCount >= 2, and 55-tick RTT cooldown + dMe >= 92 floor on 10%B assist poke
variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: Counting in-flight outgoing troops (myOut) in totB when computing avail = Math.min(B - fee, (B + myOut) - fee - keep) violates conservation of home defense: every pulse X moved from B to myOut leaves totB unchanged (only decreasing by the 1.17% fee), so avail does not decrease across consecutive pulses! Combined with period=2 (112ms), inflight=2t (< WebSocket RTT 14..28t), maxTargets=6, oppFloorCap=38, and isPrimeLand keep=10*L..26*L, a frontline bot at d=100..120 fires 5..14 pulses in 90 ticks until home density B_home/L drops to 0..28 (181 hollow-out snapshots across G01-G09, 43 major frontline drain cascades across 8/8 losses vs 0 in winning G07). Worse, in tryDonateToTeammate, the 10%B assist poke runs every 2 ticks before server echo updates g.hasAttack(me, q), causing 7..14 consecutive 10%B pokes (0.89^14 = 19.3% balance left) that hollow out frontline anchors right in front of d=115..130 enemies.

topCoreVariableRanking.oneLineReason: totB=B+myOut + oppFloorCap=38 + keep<=10*L hollowed out frontline home density to d=27.8~33.8 in G04 (and d=0~14.6 across G01-G09), causing 100% of midgame #1 leads to get counter-swept.
2-tick RTT assist machine-gun bug caused noah88 to fire 10x10%B (t=5042) and 14x10%B (t=6594, -81% B) in G04 right before Team 2 counter-attacked.
79 micro-donations (pct=51) in G04 burned 6.10M troops in flat 6.25%B engine tax to deliver 4.96M (55.2% loss) and drained frontline carry leo_tx down to d=70~78.
145 boats (61 sea intercepts) in G04 burned >1.8M troops/tax due to broken bQ.mt.mu deduplication and 35%B chase cap.
2/8 bots in G04 hit voronoi=500 island fallback at spawn, reducing main-continent opening presence to 6 bots.
